# LabelPlacement

`Flare.Components.LabelPlacement`

Position of a control's label relative to the control (checkbox, radio, switch).

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `End` | `0` | Label after the control (default, e.g. to the right in LTR). |
| `Start` | `1` | Label before the control (e.g. to the left in LTR). |

## Used by components

- `FlareCheckbox`
- `FlareRadioGroup`
- `FlareSwitch`
